newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PCIBank revises stock rights offer.
newsitem.headline: PCIBank revises stock rights offer.

text.p: The Philippine Commercial International Bank (PCIBank) has revised its stock rights offer following the steep fall in its share price, underwriter PCI Capital Corp said on Monday.

PCI Capital told the Philippine Stock Exchange that new shares would be sold at a 20 percent discount from the final weighted average price in the 15 days before the price-setting date. PCIBank shares closed at 260 pesos on Monday.
Earlier, the bank had pegged the rights price at 305 pesos when the shares were still trading at 390 pesos.
Local bank shares have been sold down since April as fears of a Thailand-style financial crisis spooked investors.
It said the ratio would be set depending on the rights price, instead of the earlier announced one-for-ten ratio.
The bank hopes to raise five billion pesos from the rights issue to boost its capital.
